finding: NativeReportAccumulator mutates report state before all snapshot validation completes. After a conflicting Funding fact raised MetricsError, callers could catch the exception and still call add_snapshot or finish, allowing partial ledger state to be reused.
reproduction: Two new regressions first failed against the previous implementation: add_snapshot after the collision did not raise, and finish did not report the earlier failure.
change: NativeReportAccumulator now records the first exception from snapshot ingestion or report finalization and enters a fail-closed state. Later add_snapshot/finish calls raise MetricsError chained from the original failure. Snapshot and finalization mutation logic is behind guarded internal methods.
